title: unified-rollouts: multi-stage shadow + canary auto-rollback workflow
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We need a single, composable rollout workflow that supports staged shadow probing followed by a weighted canary with automatic rollback based on multi-metric thresholds. This addresses reliability gaps found during recent large-model rollouts where noisy metrics in early shadow stages caused late regressions in canary phase.

Summary: Implements a multi-stage rollout controller and workflow that composes existing shadow and canary components. Key features: staged shadow probing (configurable probes and timeout windows), weighted canary with gradual traffic shift, multi-metric auto-rollback with hysteresis, observability hooks for per-stage metrics, and guardrails to prevent rapid rollback flapping.

Changes include: new controller/runtime state machine, workflow DSL extension to declare stages (shadow->probe->canary->ramp), metric matching logic to evaluate composite SLOs, new metrics and traces for stage transitions, and e2e tests plus unit tests for stability guards.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc + diagrams linked (ENG-8421) - [x] New controller implementation - [x] Workflow DSL extension - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] E2E canary simulation harness - [x] Docs and examples updated - [x] Observability dashboards additions

Testing notes: First CI run flagged a flaky unit test in test_rollouts::test_shadow_probe_timeout; fixed by increasing test harness timeouts and adding deterministic clock injection. Integration canary simulation runs against staging model registry with synthetic latency and error-rate regressions to verify rollback triggers.

Backward compatibility: Workflow DSL is backward compatible; existing rollout configs continue to work. New rollout stages are opt-in.

Rollback behavior: Auto-rollback triggers when configured composite metric breaches thresholds for the configured evaluation window. Hysteresis: an additional stabilization window prevents immediate re-rollout for the same model within 30 minutes.

Related: builds on prior autorollback work (see pr-61234, pr-72811) and addresses field reports SUP-1284.

Release notes: Adds multi-stage shadow probing and weighted canary autorollback workflow with observability and stability guards.

Design links: Linear ENG-8421 (design), RFC link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8421/multi-stage-shadow-canary-autorollback

merge_commit_message:
squash! unified-rollouts: multi-stage shadow + canary auto-rollback workflow

Compose staged shadow probing and weighted canary with multi-metric auto-rollback and stability guards
release_notes: Adds a multi-stage rollout workflow: staged shadow probing, weighted canary, and multi-metric auto-rollback with hysteresis. Includes observability hooks and e2e simulation tests. Opt-in via workflow DSL.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for state machine and metric evaluator. Integration tests simulate canary traffic and flapping scenarios. E2E harness validates rollback triggered by synthetic error-rate/latency regressions. Fixed a flaky test by injecting deterministic clock in test harness.
rollout_plan: Deploy controller to staging, run e2e simulation against staging model registry, enable feature flag for a handful of internal services for 48 hours, monitor rollback metrics and dashboards, then enable org-wide with gradual ramp.
known_limitations: Current metric evaluator evaluates up to 5 metrics concurrently; large composite rules may need tuning
Hysteresis window is applied per model id and shared across orgs in this release (per-org config coming in follow-up)
Edge case: extremely bursty traffic can delay detection in very short evaluation windows
